title: Pocketwire Personal Account Holders: Direct-Deposit Supplement on the Pocketwire Rewards Anniversary Bonus
content:
The Pocketwire Rewards anniversary bonus carries a direct-deposit supplement for members whose linked Pocketwire Personal Account is on a paid plan and received direct deposits over the last twelve months.

## Rule

The anniversary direct-deposit supplement is 1500 points when the direct deposits received by the linked personal account within the last twelve months total at least 40000 USD and that account is on Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Summit; it is 750 points when the account does not meet that first condition but its direct deposits within the last twelve months total at least 12000 USD and it is on Pocketwire Plus, Pocketwire Prime, Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Summit; and it is nothing otherwise. The supplement is added to the anniversary bonus credited for the anniversary, in whole points.

The records read are the plan of the linked Pocketwire Personal Account and the direct deposit entries on that account's ledger. A date lies within the last twelve months when it is later than the same calendar day twelve months before the handling date and not later than the handling date.

## Supplement by plan and deposits

| Plan of the linked personal account | Direct deposits within the last twelve months | Supplement |
|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Summit | 40000 USD or more | 1500 points |
| Pocketwire Onyx or Pocketwire Summit | 12000 USD or more, below 40000 USD | 750 points |
| Pocketwire Plus or Pocketwire Prime | 12000 USD or more | 750 points |
| any of the four paid plans named | below 12000 USD | nothing |
| Pocketwire Lite or Pocketwire Core | any amount | nothing |

## Hypothetical cases

- A Pocketwire Summit account received exactly 40000.00 USD of direct deposits in the window: 1500 points.
- A Pocketwire Plus account received 45000.00 USD: the first condition needs Onyx or Summit, so it is not met; the deposits reach 12000 USD on a named plan, so the supplement is 750 points.
- A Pocketwire Core account received 50000.00 USD: nothing.
